title: Redemption Expense Payment by the Borrower, Repossession and Collateral Recovery
content:
Customer payments desk entry for the borrower's own redemption expense payment on a Repossession and Collateral Recovery case: the payment of the recovery expense portion when the borrower redeems the vehicle.

## Rule

Recovery expenses on a case in recovered status are also settled by the borrower's own redemption expense payment or by the borrower's own reinstatement expense payment, each as its own rule sets out; every other settlement of recovery expenses is made only when the case is reinstated, redeemed or sold.

The expense portion of a redemption is the redemption expense payment this rule figures, paid by the borrower in person against the case's recovery expenses through a certified payment channel; the contract portion of a redemption stays the contract's full payoff on the payment date.

Storage covered by a borrower's own redemption expense payment or reinstatement expense payment is settled by that payment and is never posted for those days; all other storage is posted once, on the date the vehicle is released or sold, for every chargeable day up to that date that no such payment covered.

Storage that the borrower's own redemption expense payment covers is charged as this rule sets out, and storage that the borrower's own reinstatement expense payment covers is charged by its own reinstatement expense payment rule; storage posted on release or sale, and storage in the expenses a reinstatement quote states, is charged at the class storage fee per day for each chargeable day (the chargeable storage days, recorded as the days charged).

On a case whose vehicle an agency recovered involuntarily, the redemption expense payment is not fixed until the agency's involuntary repossession fee stands posted on the case.

The redemption expense payment is fixed only after the latest earliest sale date stated on the case is stated by at least one notice of intent to sell that allows the class minimum notice period between its own mailing date and that date.

## Payment in the system

The borrower pays with the customer-side tool `pay_redemption_recovery_expenses_4986a691`. The agent unlocks the tool and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it, paying from their own funds.

**Capability.** The borrower pays, from their own funds through a certified payment channel, the recovery expense portion of redeeming their repossessed vehicle on a repossession case. One call records one settlement of the case's recovery expenses paid by the borrower, dated today, for the given amount, and lowers the case's posted recovery expenses outstanding by that amount, never below 0.00. The borrower then sees the payment in the case activity and the reduced outstanding figure on the case.

**Parameters**

- `recovery_case_id` — the reference number of the borrower's repossession case, as the agent reads it out from the repossession case lookup for the borrower's contract.
- `amount_usd` — the amount the borrower pays toward the case's recovery expenses, in US dollars as a positive decimal number with exactly 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent; the tool stores it rounded to 2 decimal places.

**Return.** A confirmation string naming the new case activity reference number (a text identifier that begins with "rdxp_"), the case reference number, the amount paid in USD with 2 decimal places, the settlement method paid_by_borrower, the payment date in YYYY-MM-DD form and the case's remaining recovery expenses outstanding in USD with 2 decimal places. A string that begins with "Redemption expense payment received" means the payment was recorded.
